objective: Pin CI base tooling (pip, setuptools, wheel) to secure supported versions to eliminate unpinned base-image drift and make Dependency Audit reproducible
previous_knowledge_consumed: PR #203 CI success (Run 39246108938): Format Check, Lint, Lifecycle Gate, Test Suite, Build, Audit all PASS — formatting already isolated from scientific changes

Local pip_audit on system pip 23.0.1 / setuptools 66.1.1 reported 20 PYSEC vulnerabilities (PYSEC-2023-228, PYSEC-2026-1795/1796/2875/2876/196/3721, PYSEC-2025-49, PYSEC-2026-1918/3447) — CI audit passed only because CI upgrades to latest, but without pin reproducibility is not guaranteed
Verified locally: pip==26.2 + setuptools==84.0.0 resolves all PYSEC and is compatible with Python 3.11.16, ruff 0.16.9, build, pytest 586 passed

baseline.description: Workflows use `pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel` without pin — CI audit passes by fetching latest, but local system pip 23.0.1/setuptools 66.1.1 still vulnerable and pin is not reproducible; scientific-validation.yml used `pip install --upgrade pip` without setuptools/wheel at all

expected_improvement: Dependency Audit reproducible and not dependent on floating base-image versions
Local and CI environments both report no known vulnerabilities when using pinned versions

reliability.before: CI used floating --upgrade pip setuptools wheel (7 places in ci.yml + 4 in scientific-validation.yml + 1 in release.yml + 1 in product-scope-audit.yml)
reliability.after: All 13 places pinned to pip==26.2 setuptools==84.0.0 wheel==0.48.0 — CI audit still success, local pip_audit reports 0 vulns
reliability.evidence: local pip_audit before: 20 vulns; after pip==26.2/setuptools==84.0.0: No known vulnerabilities; CI Run 39246108938 audit was success even before pin, pin makes it deterministic

correctness.before: scientific-validation.yml upgraded only pip, missing setuptools/wheel pin
correctness.after: scientific-validation.yml now upgrades pip, setuptools, wheel together with same pins as ci.yml
correctness.evidence: grep -n pip install in all workflows shows consistent pinned triple

evidence: Pinned workflow install tested locally: pip 26.2 + setuptools 84.0.0 + ruff check PASS + build PASS + pip check PASS + pip_audit PASS (0 vulns)
No scientific baseline, model, feature, class order, or validation gate changed — only .github/workflows/*.yml
CI environment hardening is independent from CPVS scientific claim; CPVS 11,602 extra remains UNRESOLVED

root_causes: Base-image drift: unpinned --upgrade could fetch different pip/setuptools per run; local system pip 23.0.1 remained vulnerable while CI fetched latest

findings: Pin CI base tooling to the exact secure versions that pass pip_audit (pip 26.2, setuptools 84.0.0) — floating --upgrade is convenient but not reproducible
Scientific-validation workflow must pin the same triple as CI — otherwise audit coverage is inconsistent
Local system pip/setuptools vulnerabilities do not automatically mean lockfile is vulnerable; they indicate base-image hygiene, not project dependencies

knowledge_carried_forward: CI base tooling pinned to pip==26.2 setuptools==84.0.0 wheel==0.48.0 across all workflows
License deprecation remains open (needs LICENSE decision) — not changed
API/joblib hardening remains open (needs deployment policy) — not changed
CPVS 11,602 extra remains unresolved — scientific lane independent
